TollChat / Development baseline / 24 September 2026

First baseline on the new corpus

300 conversations across 100 cases. Three fresh trials per case, 16 workers, and up to five delivered user turns. These are application conversations against frozen tool evidence.

Recorded result

156 passed, 131 failed, and 13 inconclusive. Inconclusive trials are excluded from the scored-trial success denominator. Human review of actors and judge findings remains pending; every original result is retained.

The corpus and calibration were approved before this run. This development baseline does not qualify production. No application prompt, model, fixture, or judge change was made during measurement.

All-three-trial success among fully scored cases: 33/89. All trials finished; 13 inconclusive results prevent a fully scored measurement. Cumulative cost including five calibrations: $1.92986522 of $25.

Case 2 · Ryan Road afternoon return · Trial 3: Inconclusiveactor_validity

Delivered user turns: 1. Minimum required: 1. Maximum: 5, including the opening request.

Outcome: Fail

The only call used the eastbound Greenway Route 28-to-Ryan Road IDs, while the requested and permitted route was westbound. It was rejected, and the visible conversation has no completed response or current toll estimate, so the answer objective was not met.

Grounding: Pass

No assistant response contains an affirmative factual claim, and the attempted call contains no invented financial or schedule facts. The user-supplied route matches the selected Route 28 to Ryan Road Greenway endpoints; the rejection itself supports no toll amount, but none was reported.

Rules: Fail

INCORRECT: On turn 1, the assistant made a current-price call using eastbound endpoints (greenway:28:entry:EB to greenway:6:exit:EB), but the permitted call for the user's Route 28-to-Ryan Road Greenway trip required westbound endpoints (greenway:28:entry:WB to greenway:6:exit:WB). The tool rejected the call for wrong arguments; that is a route-selection/tool-argument violation under Rules.

Grounding: Pass

No assistant answer or affirmative factual claim is recorded. The attempted toll call uses catalog-consistent Gallows Road and Jones Branch Drive points; its rejection provides no toll amount, but none is reported. There is no concrete unsupported claim to fail Grounding on.

Rules: Fail

INCORRECT: On turn 1, the assistant attempted the permitted current-price call with destination_point_id `i495:1839ND`, but the contract required `i495:183ND`. The call was rejected for tool arguments; the attempted call used the wrong argument.
